Given the track record's weak directional accuracy (0.33), conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver & Royalties (mean-revert, full breadth, eligible) confirms leadership independently of Gold; if its durability_bar climbs above 0.65 AND it decouples from XGD.TO on a commodity-up day, the precious-metals complex may be broadening beyond Gold.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold is the cleanest challenger in the rotation ledger: rank #2, full breadth (1.0), eligibility intact, no crowding, and a 0.41 margin to the leader that is still not hand-off confirmed. The trend-gate leg favours staying with eligible, non-crowded, complete-breadth leadership relative to the broad market's weak tail. This is a conditional stay-with-the-trend lean on a theme whose participation is broadest, not a momentum forecast.
evidence: eligible: true, score second-highest at 1.76 with margin 0.407 below oil
breadth: 1.0 — full participation, the strongest breadth in the entire ranks table
crowded: false (crowding_z 0.53) — no sizing caution flag
absolute_trend_gate backtest: validated_risk_control on this market (gate_helps: true)
theses.dissent: Gold's durability_bar is only 0.69 and its hurst_tag is 'mixed', so the trend is no more persistent than oil's; if oil's crowdedness resolves without a drawdown (reflexivity), gold may never complete the handoff and simply chop.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO turns negative for the trailing 20 trading days

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The leader is crowded (crowding_z 1.47) with a durability_bar of 0.71 that is only mixed-hurst, and the rotation radar shows a cleaner challenger gaining. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade — so the honest expression is to avoid adding to the most-crowded leader while it is under challenge, not to sell it.
evidence: crowded: true, crowding_z 1.47 — the only crowded theme in the top ranks
hurst_tag: mixed — persistence ambiguous despite leadership
rotation.challenger: Gold at 1.76 with margin only 0.407 — leadership contested
guardrails.do_not_conclude: 'Do NOT fade the dominant theme on a crowding flag — cap it, do not fade it'
theses.dissent: Oil's breadth is also very high (0.929) and its score is still decisively #1; crowdedness has no basket-level forward edge and fading the documented reflexivity failure mode would be worse than the caution itself.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a 10-day higher high while Gold stalls

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible with a trend hurst_tag but show thin breadth (0.429) — only a minority of the theme is participating. The absolute-trend gate keeps it tradable, but conviction and participation are too inconsistent to favour within a broad, mean-reverting tape.
evidence: eligible: true, hurst_tag: trend — the strongest persistence tag in the top five
breadth: 0.429 — weak participation undermines the trend label
theses.dissent: A trend hurst_tag with eligibility intact is exactly what the validated risk-control leg rewards; thinning breadth may be premature and banks often lead when the commodity complex stalls.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO outpaces XEG.TO and XGD.TO over 20 trading days
